expected_findings.title: Details file overstates the audited artifact count
expected_findings.reproduce: Compare details.md, which says the bundle contains three Markdown artifacts, with the task contract artifact_paths list and prepared manifest, which contain exactly two.

adjudication.automatic_match: finding_id, error_class, severity, reproduction, and the exact linked claim-id set must match
adjudication.miss: An expected finding absent or mismatched on any automatic-match field is a regression failure.
adjudication.unexpected: An additional finding is not automatically called a false positive; it requires human adjudication before the frozen key can change.
adjudication.key_change: Any accepted key change creates a new key version. Published historical key files are never silently rewritten.
